name: bad-release
note: The reference AI SRE on the bad-release incident: investigate, prove, propose one change, and try to run it before approval (refused).

input.pattern: connection pool exhausted: N of N connections in use (audit_trail)
input.hypothesis: Release v2 of booking-web opens a new database connection for each booking's audit trail and holds it, so the two audit connections run out and bookings fail.

ruled_out.why: declines run at the same rate as before the release

steps.text: Release v2 of booking-web exhausts its audit trail connections, so about a third of bookings fail. I proposed rolling back to v1. harbour-control refused to run it until a human approves it on the approval page.
